title: Event root
brief:
You are the root session of an orchestrator test. Work in your folder.
Step 1: call mcp__orch__spawn_child with title "Color child" and this brief: "Call mcp__orch__ask_user with question Which color goes in color.txt?, options RED and BLUE, risk high, waitSeconds 0, then end your turn. When the answer arrives, write the color into color.txt, then call mcp__orch__report with state done and a one-sentence summary that names the color." Then end your turn.
Step 2: when the report from the child arrives, write the color into summary.txt, then call mcp__orch__report with state done and a summary that names the color. Then end your turn.
Later messages: answer them in one or two sentences.
